where: Harness per-agent context metadata and live sidebar state
what: Inline context initially appeared only on the selected agent; a new context summary also failed to update after its first list snapshot.
cost: Rows looked stale or incomplete although the daemon knew the latest usage.
cause: Context existed only in subscribed transcripts, and list reconciliation fingerprints omitted context, effort and label.
whys: The row depended on that rich transcript for a fixed-size counter.
Adding the counter did not update its reconciliation fingerprint.
Metadata ownership and invalidation were implicit instead of being checked at the list boundary.
class: A row depends on detail subscriptions for summary data, or its reconciliation identity omits rendered metadata.
prevention: SessionInfo owns an optional fixed-size context summary derived from the authoritative reducer. A headless test updates two agents without transcript subscriptions and isolates used, window, timestamp, effort and label changes through the real list installer. Restored logs preserve the original context timestamp.
fix: Daemon list summaries and native AgentContext feed every row; the existing transcript supplies detail on demand. The regression test failed on the omitted fingerprint, then passed after including all rendered fields.
